tagline: Three-oscillator mono synth with ladder-style filter and glide
description: A single-voice subtractive synth: saw, pulse and triangle oscillators into a 4-pole ladder-style low-pass filter, with separate filter and amp envelopes, two LFOs and glide. Use it for monophonic bass and lead lines. Note velocity is ignored.

features.name: Three Oscillators
features.description: Saw, pulse (width 0.01-0.99) and triangle, each with its own level; oscillators 2 and 3 detune by up to 24 semitones either way, and oscillator 2 can hard-sync to oscillator 1.

features.name: Ladder-Style Filter
features.description: A four-stage tanh low-pass with cutoff from 20 Hz to 20 kHz, resonance 0-1 and envelope amount of -5000 to +5000 Hz.

features.name: Two ADSR Envelopes
features.description: Filter and amp envelopes with attack and decay up to 2 s and release up to 5 s.

features.name: Two LFOs
features.description: LFO 1 adds vibrato of up to 2 semitones and LFO 2 modulates pulse width, each at 0.1-20 Hz.
